::: {.sm-math-bootstrap aria-hidden="true"}

```{=html}
<div
  class="sm-lagrangian-app"
  id="sm-lagrangian-app"
  data-catalogue="../assets/lagrangian/catalogue.json"
>
  <div class="sm-app-aura sm-app-aura-one" aria-hidden="true"></div>
  <div class="sm-app-aura sm-app-aura-two" aria-hidden="true"></div>

  <header class="sm-app-intro">
    <p class="sm-eyebrow">Interactive field theory</p>
    <h1>The Standard Model, <span>unfolded.</span></h1>
    <p class="sm-app-lede">
      Select a phase and its sectors, then move from canonical notation to
      explicit generations, internal components, and gauge-field monomials.
      The complete selected expression is shown below and Lorentz indices stay
      covariant at every level.
    </p>
  </header>

  <section class="sm-glass sm-formula-stage" aria-label="Complete selected Lagrangian">
    <div class="sm-stage-header">
      <div class="sm-stage-stat">
        <span class="sm-stage-label">Complete expression</span>
        <strong id="sm-term-count">Loading catalogue…</strong>
      </div>
      <div class="sm-render-status" id="sm-render-status" role="status"></div>
    </div>

    <div class="sm-equation-shell" id="sm-equation-shell" aria-busy="true">
      <div class="sm-formula-track" id="sm-formula-track"></div>
      <div class="sm-loading" id="sm-loading">
        <span></span><span></span><span></span>
        <b id="sm-loading-label">Preparing the fields</b>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="sm-colour-key" id="sm-colour-key" hidden></div>

    <div class="sm-stage-footer">
      <span id="sm-level-caption">Connections</span>
      <span class="sm-stage-hint">Every additive term in the current selection is displayed.</span>
    </div>
  </section>

  <section class="sm-glass sm-controls" aria-label="Lagrangian controls">
    <div class="sm-control-block sm-phase-control">
      <span class="sm-control-title">Field basis</span>
      <div class="sm-segmented" role="group" aria-label="Field basis">
        <button type="button" data-phase="unbroken" aria-pressed="true">
          Symmetric
          <small>before EWSB</small>
        </button>
        <button type="button" data-phase="broken" aria-pressed="false">
          Physical
          <small>after EWSB</small>
        </button>
      </div>
    </div>

    <fieldset class="sm-control-block sm-sector-control">
      <legend class="sm-control-title">Active sectors</legend>
      <div class="sm-sector-list" id="sm-sector-list"></div>
    </fieldset>

    <div class="sm-control-block sm-development-control">
      <div class="sm-control-heading">
        <label class="sm-control-title" for="sm-development">Development</label>
        <output id="sm-level-name" for="sm-development">Connections</output>
      </div>
      <input id="sm-development" type="range" min="0" max="4" step="1" value="2">
      <div class="sm-range-ticks" aria-hidden="true">
        <span>Canonical</span><span>Multiplets</span><span>Connections</span><span>Components</span><span>Unfolded</span>
      </div>
      <p id="sm-level-description">Covariant derivatives and field strengths are exposed.</p>
    </div>

    <fieldset class="sm-control-block sm-reading-control">
      <legend class="sm-control-title">Reading modes</legend>
      <div class="sm-mode-list">
        <label class="sm-mode-switch">
          <input id="sm-colour-mode" type="checkbox">
          <span>
            <strong>Smart colour</strong>
            <small>Field families and physical flavours</small>
          </span>
        </label>
        <label class="sm-mode-switch">
          <input id="sm-explain-mode" type="checkbox">
          <span>
            <strong>Explain symbols</strong>
            <small>Contextual notation guide</small>
          </span>
        </label>
      </div>
    </fieldset>

    <div class="sm-control-block sm-actions">
      <a
        id="sm-floating-view"
        class="sm-action-button sm-floating-button"
        href="lagrangian-floating.html"
        target="_blank"
        rel="noopener"
      >
        <span aria-hidden="true">↗</span> Floating view
      </a>
      <button type="button" id="sm-copy" class="sm-action-button">
        <span aria-hidden="true">⧉</span> Copy LaTeX
      </button>
      <button type="button" id="sm-download" class="sm-action-button sm-action-primary">
        <span aria-hidden="true">↓</span> Download .tex
      </button>
    </div>
  </section>

  <section class="sm-glass sm-explainer" id="sm-explainer" hidden aria-label="Symbol explanations">
    <div class="sm-explainer-header">
      <div>
        <p class="sm-control-title">Notation guide</p>
        <h2>Symbols in this selection</h2>
      </div>
      <p>Hover or focus a card to locate the terms that use that symbol.</p>
    </div>
    <div class="sm-symbol-groups" id="sm-symbol-groups"></div>
  </section>

  <details class="sm-glass sm-source-panel">
    <summary>
      <span>Complete LaTeX source</span>
      <small>The copied and downloaded source stays uncoloured and portable.</small>
    </summary>
    <div class="sm-source-inner">
      <pre><code id="sm-raw-latex"></code></pre>
    </div>
  </details>

  <aside class="sm-scope-note">
    <strong>Scope.</strong> This is the classical, gauge-invariant minimal Standard Model.
    Gauge-fixing, ghosts, the QCD theta term, right-handed neutrinos, and
    higher-dimensional operators are not included.
  </aside>

  <noscript>This interactive page requires JavaScript.</noscript>
</div>

<script defer src="../assets/lagrangian/lagrangian-app.js"></script>
```

:::
